column1: # Board families of the slot reader: one row per family, written from the public documents of the board makers
# in the form of MemorY (no text, table or drawing of a document). Rows are tried in order; the first whose maker,
# match, forms and conditions fit a board decides. Columns:
#   maker    the maker the reader finds for the board, or *
#   match    expression over "system product|board" (letters of any case)
#   forms    the locator forms the row reads (internal/explorer/names.go); every named slot must have one
#   when     S=n processor records, slots=n memory devices, per=n slots of every processor, cpu=family
#   socket   where the processor of a slot comes from: cpu, letter, bank, one, hub, or map:WORDn=socket,...
#   kind     table, global, cards, names, hub, labels, phantoms, alias, aside
#   arg      names and hub: channels,slots per channel; cards: cards per processor; alias: the family; aside: the reason
#   channels the channel names of one processor in the order of the document; ? marks a group the document does not name
#   map      table: n=channel.position (s2: starts a second processor); global: n=processor.channel.position;
#            labels: the slot labels of the manual; phantoms: the records the manual has no slot for
#   source   ids of internal/explorer/sources.tsv; none for an aside row whose reason is that no document was found
